description: Defines data types, constants, and functions related to PDCCH candidate selection and CCE calculation for 5G NR (3GPP TS 38.213/38.331).

methods.name: max_nof_monitored_pdcch_candidates
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of monitored PDCCH candidates per slot for a given subcarrier spacing.

methods.name: pdcch_candidates_common_ss_get_lowest_cce
methods.description: Generates a list of lowest CCE indices for common search space candidates.

methods.name: pdcch_candidates_ue_ss_get_lowest_cce
methods.description: Generates a list of lowest CCE indices for UE-specific search space candidates.
